tweets.text:
『🚨 速報：

ネグセ氏：「この会社の本社はどこにあるのですか？」

ノエム氏：「わかりません。」

ネグセ氏：「私もわかりません。見つけることができませんでした。しかし、ある政治活動家と関連のある登録住所は見つかりました。』

author.displayName: たまサポ(玉造順一さん勝手連)
author.bio: たまサポ(玉造順一さん勝手連)のアカウントです。よろしくお願いします。  立憲民主党 玉造順一さんTwitter https://t.co/jP7zXdB7jp  玉造順一オフィシャルサイト https://t.co/mt86wB3xbS 😀

quotedTweet.text:
🚨 BREAKING:

Neguse: "Where is this company's headquarters?"

Noem: "I don't know."

Neguse: "Neither do I. We couldn't find it. But we found a registered address linked to a political activist. This company, which received $143 million, was created eight days before this contract was awarded.

You want the American people to believe all this is legal, and that $143 million in taxpayer money just happened to go to a company with no headquarters, no website, no prior federal government work, apparently registered at or linked to a political activist's residence—and, of course, one of the subcontractors on this contract is a political firm tied to you when you were governor of South Dakota?" https://x.com/Acyn/status/2029257090318086439/video/1

author.bio: GBC | Curated content and insights covering major events and ideas from diverse perspectives.
